summary.intent: Execute Phase 60 (IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout) of CipherBox using the GSD wave-based execution workflow, hardening IPNS verification fail-closed across Rust (api-client, fuse, sdk, desktop), TypeScript (sdk-core), and the API layer.
summary.outcome: 7 of 8 plans completed successfully across 3 waves with all local cross-layer gates green (351 Rust tests, 251 sdk-core tests, 171 API ipns tests, scripts typecheck). Plan 60-08 completed its automated Task 1 but paused at a blocking human-action checkpoint (staging DB wipe + redeploy + smoke-test), leaving phase completion pending.

repo: GSD worktree isolation mode can't reliably surface the branch/path manifest back to the orchestrator, making merge-back unreliable for complex phases — sequential execution on the feature branch is the safe fallback.

Cargo.lock must be explicitly committed after any Cargo.toml dep addition; Wave 1 executor added ciborium+cipherbox-core to api-client's Cargo.toml but never committed the lockfile, creating a latent --locked CI break.

60-01 was forced to fold all 9 VerifyError::Legacy caller arms in fuse/metadata.rs as a compile necessity, pulling scope that was formally declared in 60-04 — cross-wave scope bleed is possible when compile errors force it.
docs/CAPACITY.md §1.5 was already occupied by a prior-phase re-baseline; D-11 verify-cache measurement landed correctly as §1.6 rather than overwriting.
tsconfig.scripts.json registers bench scripts; new scripts must be added there to pass the scripts typecheck gate.
ROADMAP checkbox for 60-06 was not ticked by its executor despite full completion — executor STATE/ROADMAP updates are not guaranteed; orchestrator must reconcile.

code.finding: Final VerifyError::Legacy call site; confirmed zero remaining after 60-01 folded all 9 arms — the stale E0599 diagnostic was a mid-edit snapshot, not a real compile error.
File deleted by 60-04 after 60-01 relocated the verified-IPNS-resolve chokepoint to crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs; 'not included in module tree' warning after deletion was a stale diagnostic.
60-06 bench script registered here; missing registration causes scripts typecheck failures.
§1.6 added for D-11 per-op IPNS signature verification cost measurement (2026-06); §1.5 was already occupied.

workflow: GSD commit helper reports false-negative 'No staged files match any configured task' even when the commit lands — always verify with git log rather than treating this message as a failure.
Jest output from the API ipns specs routes negative-path assertion errors to stderr, burying the pass/fail summary line; a second targeted extraction command is needed to confirm test results.

Executor subagents sometimes append stray content to SUMMARY.md files after the main commit (e.g. a 'verify.rs FOUND' footer that became factually wrong after 60-04); orchestrator should revert stray mutations.
Running cargo test --workspace as an authoritative cross-layer gate before a non-autonomous human-action plan provides a clean, controlled baseline that the executor's self-check cannot guarantee.

friction: Worktree isolation mode unsupported for merge-back in this harness, forcing a switch to sequential subagent execution and sacrificing parallelism for correctness.
Wave 1 executor left two uncommitted artifacts (Cargo.lock lockfile catch-up and stray SUMMARY.md footer), requiring orchestrator detection and manual cleanup commits.
GSD commit helper false-negatives ('No staged files match any configured task') required a confirmatory git log after every commit, adding overhead across 8 plans.
Stale mid-edit E0599 diagnostic (VerifyError::Legacy in metadata.rs:619) from 60-01 prompted an unnecessary grep+compile verification round before Wave 1 could continue.
Jest log noise from negative-path assertion errors buried the pass/fail summary, requiring a second extraction bash command.
60-06 ROADMAP checkbox inconsistency discovered late (after Wave 3 completion), requiring a separate reconciliation step at the end of the session.
